# Internal links to repoint in Evolution CMS

Generated by `npm run chunks`. See step 5 of IMPORT.md.

Each `<a href="#" data-ntgoc-link="x">` must become `<a href="[~<id>~]">`,
where `<id>` is the numeric resource id EVO assigns that page.
